thought.text: Latensi tidak stabil (1,9–15,3 s) — itu antrean server, bukan masalah model. Saya siapkan konfigurasinya.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && cat > LIGHTVELA_CONFIG.md <<'EOF'
# LightVela — konfigurasi model (abliterated:thinking)

## Model yang dipilih
```
deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated:thinking
```

| Sumbu | Nilai |
|---|---|
| Base | DeepSeek v4.1 flash 1017 |
| Abliterated | ✅ refusal dihapus dari bobot (paling bebas) |
| :thinking | ✅ reasoning menyala |
| Kecepatan | 2–36 s (tergantung antrean server) |
| Biaya | $0.0002–0.0007 per request |

## Isi form LightVela
Menu **Management -> Model -> Custom model**:

| Field | Nilai |
|---|---|
| Name | `obscurify` |
| Base URL | `https://obscurify.ai/v1` |
| Protocol | **OpenAI Chat Completions** |
| API Key | *(key dari `ob_ready.txt`)* |
| Model ID | `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated:thinking` |

## ⚠️ WAJIB: max_tokens besar
Model `:thinking` menghabiskan token untuk reasoning dulu.
Kalau `max_tokens` kecil -> `content` KOSONG.

| max_tokens | Hasil |
|---|---|
| 400 | ✅ ada (reasoning 431 char) |
| 1000 | ✅ ada (reasoning 1.586 char) |
| 2000 | ✅ aman |
| 4000 | ✅ paling aman |

**Set max_tokens 2000+.** Di LightVela cari setting output/max tokens.
Kalau tidak ada, ini risiko utama.

## Hasil uji (terukur 17 Nov)
```
max_tokens= 400  waktu=20.4s  compl=118  reasoning= 431  content=ADA   $0.000213
max_tokens=1000  waktu=17.2s  compl=376  reasoning=1586  content=ADA   $0.000641
max_tokens=2000  waktu=34.7s  compl=237  reasoning= 981  content=ADA   $0.000410
max_tokens=4000  waktu=35.8s  compl=190  reasoning= 796  content=ADA   $0.000332
```
Latensi 3x uji: 15.3s, 2.6s, 1.9s -> **tidak stabil** (antrean server, bukan model).

## Perbandingan 5 varian (prompt sama)
| Varian | Waktu | Token | Reasoning | Biaya |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-1017` | 4,7 s | 437 | 0 | $0.000345 |
| `-abliterated` | 7,3 s | 180 | 0 | $0.000309 |
| **`-abliterated:thinking`** | **8,8–36 s** | 247 | **1.532** | $0.000426 |
| `-uncensored` | **3,6 s** | 226 | 0 | $0.000203 |
| `-uncensored:thinking` | 4,0 s | 400 | 1.044 | $0.000361 |

## Kalau terlalu lambat, cadangan
```
deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored          (3,6 s, paling cepat)
deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated         (tanpa thinking)
```

## Catatan biaya
- Saldo key sekarang: **$0.46**
- Model ini ~$0.0004/request -> ~1.100 request
- Model mahal (`gpt-6-astra`) $0.075/request -> hindari
- Cek biaya nyata: `GET https://obscurify.ai/transactions/summary`
EOF
git add -A && git -c user.name="openhands" -c user.email="openhands@all-hands.dev" commit -q -m "LightVela config: abliterated:thinking with measured latency and max_tokens guidance" && git --no-pager log --oneline -1
